UnitStatement: Chirality is a formally specified agent operating system for deliverable-heavy professional work.
Chirality project truth lives in git-tracked plain files.
Chirality agents operate under invariant contracts, bounded write scopes, and human gate authority.
The theoretical foundation, regulatory grounding, and rationale for Chirality's architecture are developed in docs/thesis/.
docs/DIRECTIVE.md governs founding intent, design philosophy, and the professional responsibility model.
docs/SPEC.md governs physical structures, file formats, schemas, and folder layouts.
docs/TYPES.md governs domain vocabulary, stable IDs, enums, lifecycle states, and agent roles.
docs/CONTRACT.md governs the K-* invariant catalog of 21 binding invariants defined across CONTRACT.md section 1.
docs/DBM_Agent_Instruction_Architecture.md governs the full design basis for the instruction architecture.
docs/SE_Design_Analysis.md governs systems engineering design analysis.
CHIRALITY_FRAMEWORK.md governs Chirality Theory for knowledge, accountability, and the four pillars.
PROFESSIONAL_ENGINEERING.md governs the professional practice standard with APEGA regulatory mapping.
AGENTS.md governs the agent index and matrix.
tools/REGISTRY.md governs the deterministic tool index.
Instruction files use AGENT_* names, such as AGENT_CHANGE.md.
Agents use their role name, such as CHANGE.
All instruction files are located in agents/.
The next bootstrap step is to read AGENTS.md for the agent index and then load the agent instruction file.
The agent instruction file contains the agent's type, class, write scope, invariants, and full operational protocol.
